These are the original files of 1 Day 1 Diary.

They hold the diary the previous version (1.7.x) used, exactly as it was before moving to the new version.

- legacy-snapshot: the diary file (note.db) and settings, without your password
- media: photos moved from the previous version

If you want your entries restored, keep this file and write to sjunh812@naver.com.
